title: A design rule we keep coming back to: DeRot doesn't stand at the door.

copy.threads_text:
A design rule we keep coming back to: DeRot doesn't stand at the door.

Plenty of apps make you breathe before the feed even loads. We wait until you're mid-scroll, because that's when you actually need it.

We're not here to stop you. We're here to help you come back down.
